Each one links to its guide. Most of it is done once; the menu and the staff change over time. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Before you start (ERPNext)","key":"md_before_you_start_erpnext","id":"before-you-start-erpnext","name":"md_before_you_start_erpnext","value":"# Before you start (ERPNext) You need a working ERPNext company with: - **Items** for what you sell, in **Item Groups** that make sense for the kitchen (Food, Drinks, Desserts…). The production centers use the item groups to know what to prepare. - A **selling Price List** with a price for each item. - **Taxes** (Sales Taxes and Charges Template) and a **Warehouse** if you track stock. - **Modes of Payment** (Cash, Credit Card…) with their accounts."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Set up Ren POS","key":"md_set_up_ren_pos","id":"set-up-ren-pos","name":"md_set_up_ren_pos","value":"# Set up Ren POS 1. **[Restaurant](/Docs/Restaurant)**: create it, set its company, default customer and table policy. 2. **[POS Profile](/Docs/POS%20Profile)**: create one for the restaurant (price list, taxes, payment methods) and list the cashiers. 3. **[Staff and roles](/Docs/Staff%20and%20Roles)**: add every person who works there with their role and what they work. 4. **[Floors, rooms and tables](/Docs/Floor%20Plan)**: draw the dining room on the POS. 5. **[Production centers](/Docs/Production%20Centers)**: one per station that prepares food or drinks, with its item groups and flow. 6. **[Menus and items](/Docs/Menus%20and%20Items)**: build the menu and set it as the restaurant's active menu. Add [options and combos](/Docs/Options%20and%20Combos) where you need them. 7. **[Printers](/Docs/Printers)**: kitchen tickets, bills and the cash drawer (optional: the browser can print too). 8. Optional, when you need them: [card payments](/Docs/Card%20Payments), [delivery](/Docs/Delivery), [online and QR ordering](/Docs/Online%20Ordering), [reservations](/Docs/Reservations%20Setup) and [recipes](/Docs/Recipes)."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Try it","key":"md_try_it","id":"try-it","name":"md_try_it","value":"# Try it Log in as a waiter, open the cash register if you charge, tap a table, add a few items and **Send**. Open the kitchen screen from the production column on the right and move the items along. Then **Pay**. See [Taking orders](/Docs/Taking%20Orders). > The **Restaurant** workspace in the Desk has an onboarding panel with these same steps; it ticks them off as you go."}}]}]
